paragraphs: The 125d is a 2.0‑litre four‑cylinder turbo diesel that was part of the 1 Series range from 2011 to 2019. It was available only in the F20/F21 hatchback generation — the later F40 generation dropped the 125d badge. Across its production run, the 125d used two different engines: the N47 from 2011 to 2015, and the B47 from 2015 onwards. The N47 is known for a timing chain wear issue, while the B47 is a significantly revised engine that addressed that problem. Knowing which engine your car has matters for the rebuild approach, which is why we always confirm by registration before quoting. The 125d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0‑litre four‑cylinder diesel fitted to the 125d from 2011 to 2015 (F20/F21). Known for timing chain guide wear — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, guides, tensioners and gaskets as standard on every N47 rebuild.

The later 2.0‑litre four‑cylinder diesel, fitted from 2015 to the end of F20/F21 production in 2019. BMW moved the timing chain to a more reliable position and made other internal revisions. It does not share the N47's well‑documented timing chain issue, though we still inspect and replace components as needed during a rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because BMW 125d can use the N47 or B47 engine code, fitting the wrong replacement risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (N47 or B47) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic 125d quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
